invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata; null is unexpected and may indicate errors.
The parameter should be a non-null list; nulls typically would cause a failure earlier.
A valid instantTime should be non-null and non-empty to perform write operations.
The getWriteStatuses() should provide a valid List as part of the metadata contract.
The number of WriteStatus objects must be zero or more; negative size is impossible.
